technical.summary: Mixed signals with short-term bullish technicals (Hull flip, PSar, Supertrend) offset by weak intermediate trend structure, below key moving averages, and negative volume/momentum indicators; insufficient confluence for high-probability entry.

fundamental.summary: TXN shows no actionable smart money signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, absent government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 69 days adds timing risk.

sentiment.congressional_conviction: medium — mixed sizes, recent purchases by mid-tier members
sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (10/10) with recent congressional purchases creates contrarian buy setup, though conviction is moderate and news data unavailable for confirmation.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX in crisis territory (417.4), flat yield curve signals recession risk, rising DXY pressures multinational earnings, and earnings event in 69 days adds execution risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Hull flip, PSar, and Supertrend bullish signals combined with extreme fear sentiment (10/10) and congressional buying create a contrarian entry opportunity near support (154.23) with defined risk.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (VIX crisis, flat yield curve, rising DXY), price below all key moving averages, negative momentum (RSI falling, CMF/AO negative), weak technical confluence, and earnings risk in 69 days make this a low-probability setup with unfavorable risk/reward.

decision.entry_rationale: While extreme fear sentiment and congressional buying create contrarian appeal, severe macro headwinds (VIX crisis, flat yield curve, rising DXY) combined with price below all key moving averages and negative momentum indicators create unfavorable risk/reward. Earnings in 69 days adds execution risk without sufficient technical confluence to justify entry.
